455:t_3:95.en:
$$クレア$$
「$$アクエリオン$$'s power is the power of feelings... Perhaps you two should be more honest with yourselves as well.」

455:t_3:97.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What's wrong? Are you worried about your sister?」

455:t_3:98.en:
$$シリウス$$
「No... It's $$ミカゲ$$ I'm thinking about...」

455:t_3:99.en:
$$シュレード$$
「The other half of his soul and Supreme Commander $$不動$$ are tracking him down. We can only wait.」

455:t_3:101.en:
$$シリウス$$
(I can tell, because I once became an $$天翅$$ myself...)

455:t_3:102.en:
$$シリウス$$
(That $$堕天翅$$ $$ミカゲ$$'s hatred was not directed solely at us...)

455:t_3:103.en:
$$シリウス$$
(What does he hate...? And where is that hatred headed...?)

455:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$ランド$$. You always look exhausted after facing $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

455:t_10:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「For the sake of my mental health too, I need to settle things with her soon.」

455:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I, for one, wholeheartedly welcome how faithfully she follows her desires.」

455:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Her excitement while fighting $$ミカゲ$$ produced 100Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add those to the squad's stock.」

455:t_10:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Excitement, huh... Isn't she the only woman who'd enjoy fighting a guy like that?」

455:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Her taste for freaks truly is remarkable. It is beyond an ordinary person's understanding.」

455:t_10:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey! Hold on, $$ＡＧ$$! What's that supposed to mean!?」

455:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Excuse me. It's nearly time to open $$Ｄトレーダー$$, so I'll be going~」

455:t_10:17.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「...We haven't had much chance to talk with all the chaos, but we're a past life and her reincarnation, aren't we?」

455:t_10:18.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yes... Though like $$アポロ$$ and $$カグラ$$ said, we aren't much alike.」

455:t_10:19.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Isn't that fine? I'm me, and you're you, $$ミコノ$$.」

455:t_10:21.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Besides... If we were exactly alike, I'd worry $$アマタ$$'s eyes might wander...」

455:t_10:22.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Even when you two are that lovey-dovey, you're still worried?」

455:t_10:23.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Because $$アマタ$$... was a fan of $$シルフィ$$ in '《$$アクエリアの舞う空$$》'...」

455:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Allow me to explain. '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$' is an epic love story set against the battle between humanity and the $$堕天翅$$s.」

455:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. The hero is $$アポロン$$, otherwise known as $$アポロ$$, and his love interest is $$シルフィ$$, otherwise known as $$シルヴィア$$.」

455:t_10:28.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I-I can't believe there's something like that...」

455:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アルト$$ and the others found it amusing and are already trying to show it to $$アポロ$$, but...」

455:t_10:30.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「D-don't! Even if it's fiction, something like that...!」

455:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They're screening it in the $$クォーター$$'s briefing room. It should be starting around now...」

455:t_10:34.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Y-yes...! I'll show you the way!」

455:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... $$シルヴィア$$...! We still have the induction ceremony...!」

455:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well... Never mind... There's no need to rush it.」

455:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I'll do it myself for the first time in a while! Let's get fired up for... business, business today too!」

456:t_001:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You've got some nerve, you washed-up $$堕天翅$$! Guys! Give him a taste of his own medicine!」

456:t_002:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I like it, I like it! Fighting something inhuman really gets my heart racing too!」

456:t_002:1.en:
$$レズン$$
「Tch! The $$ザフト$$ troops have been wiped out!」

456:t_002:2.en:
$$レズン$$
(I know we had no choice but to join forces with the Empire to survive...)

456:t_002:3.en:
$$レズン$$
(But $$フル・フロンタル$$...! I don't like how you use the $$シャア・アズナブル$$ faction and $$ザフト$$ as bullet shields...!)

456:t_002:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now, let's go, warriors of $$ネオ・ジオン$$! You'll fight to protect that blue Earth!」

456:t_002:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sinner. Do you intend to add the further sin of turning your blade against me?」

456:t_002:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「If I worried about that, I couldn't enjoy fighting!」

456:t_002:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You are foolish, $$サイデリアル$$... You cannot be saved.」

456:t_002:9.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「While our washed-up $$堕天翅$$ is putting on airs, it seems some surprise guests have arrived.」

456:t_003:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed engagement between $$堕天翅$$s and Imperial forces! The Imperial forces include $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

456:t_003:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Supreme Commander $$エルーナルーナ$$ is on the front lines with the Imperial forces!」

456:t_003:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So $$ミカゲ$$ is targeting $$蒼の地球$$, and the $$新地球皇国$$ is defending it.」

456:t_003:4.en:
$$メール$$
「But $$エルーナルーナ$$'s lackeys aren't here!」

456:t_003:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's convenient for us. Things get complicated when $$ダバラーン$$ shows up.」

456:t_003:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So you want a date with me without $$ダバラーン$$ getting in the way too, Darling.」

456:t_003:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「What you call a date is trying to kill each other.」

456:t_003:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aha! You really do understand me, Darling!」

456:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「She is the same as ever.」

456:t_003:10.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm used to girls chasing me, but this time, I feel sorry for $$ランド$$.」

456:t_003:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What happened to $$ダバラーン$$ and the $$ハイアデス$$? Did you fire them for losing at $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$?」

456:t_003:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No, no! $$アウストラリス$$ ordered us not to waste elite troops on a battle like this.」

456:t_003:14.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Don't be so angry. That wouldn't be any fun, so I used my authority as Supreme Commander to come here myself.」

456:t_003:15.en:
$$レズン$$
(So $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is being used as expendable pawns...!)

456:t_003:16.en:
$$シャア$$
「This is the Empire's way, Ensign $$レズン$$. Being humanity's successors under their name means nothing.」

456:t_003:17.en:
$$レズン$$
「You have no right to tell us how to live, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

456:t_003:18.en:
$$クェス$$
「Nothing will change if you keep being that stubborn...!」

456:t_003:19.en:
$$レズン$$
「We'll change things...! $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will change the world!」

456:t_003:21.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units! This will be a three-way battle between us, the Imperial forces, and the $$堕天翅$$s!」

456:t_003:22.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our duty now is to defend $$蒼の地球$$! The black $$アクエリオン$$ is our highest-priority target!」

456:t_003:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミコノ$$'s in the starting lineup!?」

456:t_003:25.en:
$$シン$$
「Did something happen to $$カイエン$$!?」
